assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission using provisional geometry and participant design layers, but no statutory control or parcel-level implementation conclusion may be inferred.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough substitutes registered by the repository, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Every land-use, building, mobility, public-space, phasing, and area metric must be recalculated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Operators, funding patterns, event calendars, testbeds, and governance bodies are proposed actor types and mechanisms only.
assumptions.impact: No named institution is represented as having committed funding, approval, data, space, or operating responsibility.

assumptions.statement: Scenario success thresholds, accessibility coverage, public-space use, energy, and community participation targets require a baseline survey.
assumptions.impact: Performance directions remain qualitative until a professional team establishes lawful data sources, methods, and review intervals.
